categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Meorient Commerce & Exhibition Inc. primarily operates in the overseas exhibition industry, focusing on planning, organizing, promoting, and operating exhibitions to support Chinese enterprises and industries going global. The company hosts self-owned branded exhibitions and also acts as an agent for foreign exhibitions. It has developed specialized professional exhibitions across various industries including building materials, home furnishings, electronics, textiles, and industrial machinery, with a strong emphasis on markets along the Belt and Road, BRICS countries, and RCEP member states.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital and AI technologies to enhance exhibition services, including AI-driven buyer-seller matching algorithms, AI consultation assistants, and data-driven O2O (online-to-offline) platforms. It integrates AI hardware such as AI glasses for immersive exhibition experiences and employs big data analytics for global trade data management. These technologies enable full-chain digital empowerment across pre-exhibition, on-site, and post-exhibition phases, improving efficiency and precision in trade matchmaking.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are Chinese exporters and manufacturers seeking to expand their international market presence, especially in Belt and Road countries, BRICS nations, and RCEP markets. The company serves over 7,500 enterprises from more than 20 provinces in China, spanning industries like construction, home appliances, textiles, industrial equipment, and consumer electronics. It also attracts professional buyers globally, facilitating B2B trade connections and market entry for Chinese brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strategic focus on Belt and Road countries, BRICS nations, and RCEP member states. It has established exhibition platforms and subsidiaries in key locations including Indonesia, UAE (Dubai), Japan, Poland, Brazil, Mexico, South Africa, and the United States. Its global footprint covers Asia, Europe, the Americas, Africa, and the Middle East, with local teams and partnerships supporting localized exhibition operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meorient operates primarily in the midstream of the trade supply chain as a service provider facilitating international trade through exhibitions. It acts as a platform connecting manufacturers (suppliers) with buyers (demand side), enabling market access and business matchmaking rather than producing goods itself. The company also supports downstream activities by helping enterprises launch new products and brands internationally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include deepening its global exhibition layout, especially in Belt and Road, BRICS, and RCEP markets, and accelerating digital and AI-driven transformation of exhibition services. It invests in AI research and development to enhance buyer-seller matching, digital engagement, and operational efficiency. The firm also focuses on professionalizing exhibitions by industry verticals and expanding its China Brand Exhibition Outbound Incubation Platform to foster domestic brand globalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through exhibition-related services including venue leasing, booth sales for self-organized exhibitions, commission from agency exhibitions, and digital exhibition services. The company also earns from value-added services such as buyer matchmaking, marketing, and consulting. It receives government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Meorient is positioned as a leading domestic player and the first publicly listed private exhibition company in China focusing on overseas self-organized exhibitions. It holds the top rank in China’s overseas exhibition market by number and area of exhibitions organized. Competitors include other domestic and international exhibition organizers, but Meorient differentiates itself through its extensive global network, digital innovation, and specialization in Belt and Road and emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 751 million, a 10% decrease year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 155 million, down 17.5%. Total assets stood at RMB 831 million with equity of RMB 622 million. Despite recent revenue declines, the company has shown strong recovery compared to pre-pandemic levels, with a 76% revenue increase since 2019. It maintains a healthy net asset return rate of 24.39%. The company continues to invest in growth through acquisitions and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meorient offers a unique value proposition by combining deep industry expertise, extensive global exhibition networks, and cutting-edge AI and digital technologies to provide efficient, precise, and comprehensive trade facilitation services. Its proprietary AI-powered platforms and big data capabilities enable superior buyer-seller matching and enhanced exhibition experiences. The company’s focus on professional, industry-specific exhibitions and localized overseas operations helps Chinese enterprises effectively enter and expand in key international markets, especially in emerging economies.
